speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
text: asked the Minister for National Development whether the Ministry will introduce a licensing requirement for pet boarding businesses in addition to the standards and best practices listed in the Code of Animal Welfare (for the Pet Industry).

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: The first clarification is: how long is this review going to take?

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: I am asking this so that we can do spot checks on these pet boarders.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: We do have this Code but, again, we need to start to check on them, rather than being reactive, which means, whenever a complaint comes in, abuse has happened and then we check the pet boarders.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: Can we be proactive now and do spot checks to make sure that abuse does not happen in the first place?

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: On the timeline that the Member asked, as I mentioned earlier in my reply, we will be revealing more details in due course, but rest assured that it is going to be a holistic review.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: We will be engaging various stakeholders when we conduct this review.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: I had mentioned pet owners, industry players and Animal Welfare Groups because there is a delicate balance that we need to seek between their various needs and their interests.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
text: I understand that we have a list of the boarders at the pet farms.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
text: But as with the recent case of the Platinum Dogs Club, it was not in the pet farm, and that is perhaps where the issue lies.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
text: Do we have a list of pet boarders outside the pet farms?

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
text: Again, I really hope that the Senior Parliamentary Secretary can provide at least some timeframe of how long this review is going to take because I am pretty sure that that would be the question on the ground.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: But like I mentioned earlier, we will be undertaking a holistic review.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: But rest assured, it is going to be a holistic review.
